title: RTISSLAM-3D: Full 6-DoF SLAM With an In-Air 3D Imaging Sonar
description:
arXiv:2610.22552v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Echolocating bats navigate dense forests using sonar alone, and in-air 3D imaging sonars now capture the entire frontal hemisphere with every pulse. Sonar SLAM, however, has so far been planar: current systems estimate a 2D trajectory and discard the elevation information in the sonar images, an assumption that does not hold on rough and sloped terrain such as a forest floor.
